searched.title: Bambu Lab US store product page: H2D TPU High-Flow Kit
searched.note: The P0 corpus copy, parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload, manifest row). Its Product Specifications table gives Materials "Plastic, Metal", Packaging Size 105*54*33 mm, Color "Black" and Packaging Weight 46.9 g, all at product scope (kept by the deterministic layer; the page does not say which option they describe). Its description adds a nozzle-size flow comparison table, a Filament Compatibility list, an In the Box table and an "Important Notice Before Purchase". It states no maximum nozzle temperature, nozzle material, product dimensions, net weight, filament diameter or electrical value.

searched.title: TPU High Flow Kit for the H2D Series | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: The product's own installation and use guide, linked from the store page. Read in full (cached HTML and text). It gives the kit content, precautions, compatible models, required tools, the Volumetric Flow Rate table (85A and 90A rows) and layer-height guidance per nozzle size. Its 250 °C (load) and 100 °C (unload) temperatures are procedure settings, not a maximum nozzle temperature. Its "85A TPU: Only use with the H2D Flexible Filament Top-feed Rack" (a MakerWorld model) and its TPU feed assist recommendation are not stored. No dimensions, weight, nozzle material, filament diameter or electrical value.

searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached text omits the tab panels). The "TPU Hotend" panel (purchase link "H2D TPU High-Flow Kit") gives "Compatibility: H2D and H2D Pro (Right Hotend)" and "Size: 0.4mm/ 0.6mm" and repeats the precautions; the Nozzle-Printer Compatibility table has the row "TPU Hotend | H2D and H2D Pro (Right Hotend)". Unlike the other panels it gives no "Max. Printing Temp" and no "Materials" line. Its general Size and Materials tables are not specific to this hotend.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: A general guide for every Bambu nozzle. Its Nozzle table has no column for the TPU High-Flow hotend: its "0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 mm High flow nozzle" columns are the H2 series high-flow hotend (TPU 85A there: "Not Compatible" / "Not Recommended"), so none of its cells is applied to this product. Its nozzle temperatures (TPU rows "200 - 250") are per filament, not values of this hotend.

specs.source_title: TPU High Flow Kit for the H2D Series | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Overview › Precautions › item 2 ("Only flexible filaments are allowed")
specs.quote: Only flexible filaments are allowed: The TPU hotend has a special inner coating, printing hard filaments is prohibited (such as PLA, PETG, TPU for AMS)
specs.note: PLA, PETG and TPU for AMS are the source's examples of hard filaments, not a complete list. The manual continues "otherwise it will cause the coat to wear and fail". The store page's notice item 2 and the nozzles wiki TPU Hotend panel say the same.

specs.locator: Option group "Size" › value "0.4 mm High-Flow TPU Hotend"
specs.note: The nozzles wiki TPU Hotend panel agrees ("Size: 0.4mm/ 0.6mm"). The kit value "High-flow TPU hotends (0.4 & 0.6 mm) with accessories" holds both sizes, so it gets no single diameter (see package.contents). The deterministic parse records no nozzle.diameter for this page.

specs.locator: Option group "Size" › value "0.6 mm High-Flow TPU Hotend"
specs.note: The nozzles wiki TPU Hotend panel agrees ("Size: 0.4mm/ 0.6mm"). The deterministic parse records no nozzle.diameter for this page.

specs.source_title: TPU High Flow Kit for the H2D Series | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Printing Guidelines › Volumetric Flow Rate › table › row "90A" › columns "0.4mm TPU Nozzle" and "0.6mm TPU Nozzle"
specs.quote: TPU Hardness | 0.4mm TPU Nozzle | 0.4mm Standard Nozzle | 0.6mm TPU Nozzle | 0.6mm Standard Nozzle … 90A | 5.6 mm³/s | 2.8 mm³/s | 5.6 mm³/s | 2.8 mm³/s
specs.note: Both TPU hotend sizes give 5.6 mm³/s with 90A TPU, so the row is product-wide. The store page's comparison table agrees for 90A. Other filaments (one row per scope, not stored): 85A, 0.4 mm: wiki 2.2, store page 2.5 mm³/s (the sources disagree); 85A, 0.6 mm: 4.8 mm³/s in both; 95A HF: 16 mm³/s for both sizes, store page only. The standard H2D hotend gives 2.8 mm³/s with 90A.

specs.value: The TPU hotend must be used with the TPU-dedicated hotend cover (included in the High Flow Kit); it differs structurally from the standard H2 series hotend.
specs.source_title: TPU High Flow Kit for the H2D Series | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.quote: The TPU dedicated hotend differs structurally from the standard H2 series hotend and must be used in conjunction with the TPU dedicated hotend cover.
specs.note: The nozzles wiki TPU Hotend panel says the same. The cover is in the High Flow Kit (store In the Box: "TPU Hotend Cover | 1"; manual Kit content: "5. TPU Hotend Cover"); no separate store listing for it is known.

specs.value: Layer heights below 0.2 mm are not recommended with the 0.4 mm TPU hotend.
specs.source_title: TPU High Flow Kit for the H2D Series | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Printing Guidelines › Print Parameters › 2) Layer height recommendation › item 1
specs.quote: 0.4mm Nozzle: Not recommended for use with layer heights below 0.2mm.
specs.note: The manual gives only this lower limit, so no printing.layer_height range is stored (the general 0.1–0.3 mm guidance of the nozzles wiki Size table would contradict it).

specs.value: Bambu Lab recommends the 0.6 mm TPU hotend first (larger channel, lower resistance); layer heights below 0.3 mm are not recommended with it.
specs.source_title: TPU High Flow Kit for the H2D Series | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Printing Guidelines › Print Parameters › 1) and 2) item 2
specs.quote: Prioritize using the 0.6mm TPU nozzle - The 0.6mm nozzle has a larger channel, lower resistance … 0.6mm Nozzle: Not recommended for use with layer heights below 0.3mm.
specs.note: The manual gives only this lower limit, so no printing.layer_height range is stored.

specs.quote: 0.4 mm High-Flow TPU Hotend | 1 | 0.6 mm High-Flow TPU Hotend | 1 | TPU High-Flow Front Cover Guide | 1 | TPU Hotend Cover | 1 | Hotend Cover | 1 | M2×5 Screws for Hotend Cover | 2
specs.note: The page shows this table for the whole product, but it lists both hotends and the covers, so it is the High Flow Kit's content (each spare-use value is one hotend; the page gives no box list for those). The wiki manual's "Kit content" agrees item for item (0.6mm TPU Hotend, 0.4mm TPU Hotend, Front Guide Cover, Standard Hotend Cover, TPU Hotend Cover, M2x5 Hotend Cover Fixing Screw). The deterministic parse records no box items for this page.
